_: Postcard text for the Pro Shop's postcard versions of backgrounds (draft). name = block-letter place name on the front (max 14 chars); back = message on the back; ogre = the back in ogre mode.

bg_bfd.name: BLACKFATHOM
bg_bfd.back: Lovely and damp here! The moonwells glow all night, so no sleep. Met Aku'mai, the big local hydra. Three heads, zero manners. Wish you were here!
bg_bfd.ogre: WET HOLE. BLUE WATER. AKU HAS 3 HEAD. ALL RUDE. WISH U HERE.

bg_dm.name: THE DEADMINES
bg_dm.back: Weather in the mine: dark, with a chance of cannon. VanCleef waved his knife at me from the big pirate ship. Cookie made soup. Wish you were here!
bg_dm.ogre: DARK MINE. BIG BOAT. VAN SAY HI. COOK MAKE SOUP. WISH U HERE.

bg_gnomer.name: GNOMEREGAN
bg_gnomer.back: Everything here whirs, beeps and glows green. Thermaplugg says the glow is perfectly safe. I now also glow. Wish you were here!
bg_gnomer.ogre: GNOME TOWN. ALL GO BEEP. GREEN GLOW. NOW ME GLOW TOO. WISH U HERE.

bg_rfc.name: RAGEFIRE CHASM
bg_rfc.back: Toasty under Orgrimmar! Lava views from every rope bridge. Taragaman the Hungerer is always hungry, so bring snacks. Wish you were here!
bg_rfc.ogre: HOT HOT HOT. LAVA RIVER. BIG RED DEMON WANT SNACK. WISH U HERE.

bg_rfk.name: RAZORFEN KRAUL
bg_rfk.back: The brambles are lovely and pointy. The quilboar are very welcoming, apart from the stabbing. Charlga Razorflank sends her regards. Wish you were here!
bg_rfk.ogre: THORN MAZE. PIG MEN POKE ME. PIG LADY SAY HI. WISH U HERE.

bg_sfk.name: SHADOWFANG
bg_sfk.back: Stormy night, full moon, very romantic. Arugal keeps asking who dares interfere. Me, I said. The locals are very hairy. Wish you were here!
bg_sfk.ogre: STORM. BIG MOON. WOLF MEN VERY HAIRY. OLD MAGE YELL. WISH U HERE.

bg_stocks.name: THE STOCKADE
bg_stocks.back: Lovely stay in Stormwind's finest locked rooms. Free straw bed! Bazil Thredd started a riot, very lively. Wish you were here! (Please send key.)
bg_stocks.ogre: NICE JAIL. FREE STRAW BED. BIG RIOT. PLS SEND KEY. WISH U HERE.

bg_wc.name: WAILING CAVERN
bg_wc.back: Very green and very echoey. Naralex is asleep here having a bad dream. I know the feeling. Mutanus is the local wildlife. Wish you were here!
bg_wc.ogre: GREEN CAVE. ELF HAS BAD DREAM. ME TOO. BIG FISH MAN. WISH U HERE.

clubhouse_lounge.name: THE CLUBHOUSE
clubhouse_lounge.back: Comfy chairs, roaring fire, and my paper is upside down again. The barman is still polishing that one glass. Wish you were here!
clubhouse_lounge.ogre: COMFY CHAIR. BIG FIRE. PAPER WRONG WAY UP. WISH U HERE.

golf_course_at_dawn.name: SUNRISE GREENS
golf_course_at_dawn.back: Up at sunrise for a round! Dew on the greens, birds singing, me missing putts. Lost four balls in the pond. The ducks have them now. Wish you were here!
golf_course_at_dawn.ogre: UP EARLY. SUN COME UP. MISS PUTT. DUCK TAKE BALL. WISH U HERE.

hammock_between_two_trees.name: HAMMOCK HOLLOW
hammock_between_two_trees.back: Found two perfect trees and a hammock between them. Have not moved since Tuesday. Weather: dappled. Wish you were here, but there's no room!
hammock_between_two_trees.ogre: TWO TREE. ONE NAP BED. NO MOVE FOR DAYS. NO ROOM FOR U. SORRY.

moonlit_fairway.name: MOONLIT LINKS
moonlit_fairway.back: Sneaked out for a midnight round. Huge moon, groundskeeper asleep. Hole in one! Probably. Too dark to check. Wish you were here!
moonlit_fairway.ogre: NIGHT GOLF. BIG MOON. HOLE IN ONE. MAYBE. TOO DARK. WISH U HERE.

spa_steam_room.name: THE STEAM ROOM
spa_steam_room.back: Very relaxing! Cucumbers on my eyes, so I can't see the steam room, but I'm told it's lovely. Somebody wrote NO REFUNDS on the glass. Wish you were here!
spa_steam_room.ogre: HOT FOG. CUKE ON EYE. CANT SEE. VERY NICE. WISH U HERE.

swamp_hot_spring.name: SWAMP SPRINGS
swamp_hot_spring.back: Soaking up to my chin in the hot spring. Smells like eggs, feels like heaven. A croc borrowed my towel. Wish you were here!
swamp_hot_spring.ogre: HOT MUD BATH. SMELL LIKE EGG. CROC TOOK TOWEL. WISH U HERE.

bg_excav.name: WETLANDS DIG
bg_excav.back: Wet greetings from the Wetlands! It has rained every day, which the dwarves say is normal. They dug up some old rocks and got very excited. Wish you were here!
bg_excav.ogre: RAIN. RAIN. MORE RAIN. DWARF DIG UP OLD ROCK. SO HAPPY. WISH U HERE.

bg_mara.name: MARAUDON
bg_mara.back: Crystals, waterfalls and ferns everywhere: like a spa, but cave. Princess Theradras is huge and not a morning person. Wish you were here!
bg_mara.ogre: SHINY ROCK. BIG WATER FALL. ROCK LADY BIG AND GRUMP. WISH U HERE.

bg_rfd.name: RAZORFEN DOWNS
bg_rfd.back: Chilly here, and bonier than the brochure said. Amnennar the Coldbringer brought the cold, as promised. Pack a scarf! Wish you were here!
bg_rfd.ogre: COLD. MANY BONE. ICE MAN BRING COLD. PACK SCARF. WISH U HERE.

bg_ruins.name: LORDAERON
bg_ruins.back: Watched the sunset from an old throne room. Purple sky, broken pillars and a faint green mist. A real fixer-upper! Wish you were here!
bg_ruins.ogre: OLD KING HOUSE. ALL BROKE. NICE SKY. GREEN FOG. WISH U HERE.

bg_smarm.name: THE ARMORY
bg_smarm.back: Shopping in the Armory! Racks of swords, and the training dummies don't hit back. Herod spins a lot. Got dizzy just watching. Wish you were here!
bg_smarm.ogre: SWORD SHOP. DUMMY NO HIT BACK. RED MAN SPIN. ME DIZZY. WISH U HERE.

bg_smcath.name: THE CATHEDRAL
bg_smcath.back: The stained glass is gorgeous and the light is very holy. Whitemane said 'Arise, my champion!' so I got up. So did Mograine. Wish you were here!
bg_smcath.ogre: NICE GLASS. WHITE LADY SAY ARISE. SO ME GET UP. WISH U HERE.

bg_smgy.name: THE GRAVEYARD
bg_smgy.back: Foggy, spooky, lots of candles: very cosy really. Bloodmage Thalnos is the local ghoul, and quite chatty for a dead man. Wish you were here!
bg_smgy.ogre: SPOOK FOG. DEAD MAGE VERY CHAT. COSY. WISH U HERE.

bg_smlib.name: THE LIBRARY
bg_smlib.back: Quiet please, it's a library. Except Houndmaster Loksey, who keeps shouting 'Release the hounds!' Arcanist Doan is loud too. Wish you were here!
bg_smlib.ogre: BOOK ROOM. SHH. DOG MAN YELL. BOOK MAN YELL. NO SHH. WISH U HERE.

bg_thanes.name: HALL OF THANES
bg_thanes.back: Deep under the mountain in a grand old dwarf hall. Huge stone thanes everywhere, all with better beards than me. The forge keeps my toes warm. Wish you were here!
bg_thanes.ogre: DEEP HALL. BIG ROCK DWARF. GOOD BEARD. WARM TOES. WISH U HERE.

bg_ulda.name: ULDAMAN
bg_ulda.back: Visiting an ancient titan vault! The statues are enormous and some of them move, which wasn't in the guidebook. Archaedas says hello. Wish you were here!
bg_ulda.ogre: OLD ROCK VAULT. BIG STONE MEN. THEY MOVE. WISH U HERE.

bg_zf.name: ZUL'FARRAK
bg_zf.back: Hot sun, golden sand, lovely pyramids! I rang the big gong and Gahz'rilla came out of the pool to say hello. Bring sun cream. Wish you were here!
bg_zf.ogre: HOT SAND. BIG STEP HOUSE. BANG GONG. BIG BEAST COME. WISH U HERE.

bg_brd.name: SHADOWFORGE
bg_brd.back: Stopped at the Grim Guzzler for a Dark Iron ale. Lava rivers, iron bridges, warm and cosy. Emperor Thaurissan didn't join us. Wish you were here!
bg_brd.ogre: FIRE CITY. GOOD ALE AT BAR. LAVA. WARM. KING NO COME. WISH U HERE.

bg_dme.name: DIRE MAUL EAST
bg_dme.back: Lovely woodland walk. The trees are twisty and the flowers glow purple. Chased a tiny imp called Pusillin all the way here. Wish you were here!
bg_dme.ogre: TWIST TREE. GLOW PLANT. CHASE TINY IMP. WISH U HERE.

bg_dmn.name: GORDOK COMMONS
bg_dmn.back: Ogre country at last! Nice tents, warm campfires, and King Gordok's throne is very comfy. I sat on it. Now I'm king, apparently. Wish you were here!
bg_dmn.ogre: OGRE HOME. NICE TENT. SIT ON KING CHAIR. NOW ME KING. WISH U HERE.

bg_dmw.name: DIRE MAUL WEST
bg_dmw.back: Very posh here: marble, crystals, all very Highborne. Prince Tortheldrin was a bit rude. Immol'thar sends a big hello. Wish you were here!
bg_dmw.ogre: POSH ELF HOUSE. SHINY ROCK. ELF BOSS RUDE. WISH U HERE.

bg_lbrs.name: LOWER SPIRE
bg_lbrs.back: Black rock, spiky banners, very homely. Highlord Omokk is an ogre, so I felt welcome. Mind the spiders. Wish you were here!
bg_lbrs.ogre: BLACK ROCK. SPIKY FLAG. OGRE BOSS. LIKE HOME. MIND WEB. WISH U HERE.

bg_scholo.name: SCHOLOMANCE
bg_scholo.back: Enrolled in school at last! Green candles and very old books. Headmaster Gandling keeps sending me to other rooms. Wish you were here!
bg_scholo.ogre: NOW ME LEARN. GREEN FIRE. BIG BOSS SEND ME AWAY. WISH U HERE.

bg_st.name: SUNKEN TEMPLE
bg_st.back: Temple views, half under a lovely green lake. The dragon statues stare a bit. Eranikus is having a bad dream too, poor thing. Wish you were here!
bg_st.ogre: SUNK HOUSE. GREEN LAKE. BIG DRAKE HAS BAD DREAM. WISH U HERE.

bg_stratl.name: STRATHOLME
bg_stratl.back: The whole city is having a big bonfire. The Scarlet Crusade really like red. Grand Crusader Dathrohan is not quite what he seems. Wish you were here!
bg_stratl.ogre: TOWN ON FIRE. ALL RED FLAG. RED BOSS NOT REAL. WISH U HERE.

bg_stratu.name: THE ZIGGURATS
bg_stratu.back: The quiet side of town. Green fog, dead trees, some lovely ziggurats. Baron Rivendare is the local nobleman, and his horse is gorgeous. Wish you were here!
bg_stratu.ogre: DEAD TOWN. GREEN FOG. BARON HAS NICE HORSE. WANT. WISH U HERE.

bg_ubrs.name: UPPER SPIRE
bg_ubrs.back: Top of the Spire! Lots of dragon eggs, please don't touch. General Drakkisath has a lovely view and a bad temper. Wish you were here!
bg_ubrs.ogre: TOP OF ROCK. MANY EGG. NO TOUCH. DRAKE BOSS GRUMP. WISH U HERE.

pool_with_floaties.name: THE CLUB POOL
pool_with_floaties.back: Lazing by the club pool on a rubber duck. Sun's out, floaties out. The lifeguard is asleep, so anything goes. Wish you were here!
pool_with_floaties.ogre: POOL DAY. ME ON DUCK. SUN. GUARD SLEEP. WISH U HERE.

ancient_treasure_lounge.name: TREASURE VAULT
ancient_treasure_lounge.back: Lounging on a mountain of gold! Lumpy, but rich. Counted all the coins twice and got a different number both times. Wish you were here!
ancient_treasure_lounge.ogre: BIG GOLD PILE. LUMPY. COUNT COIN. GET LOST. WISH U HERE.

bg_barrow.name: BARROW DEEPS
bg_barrow.back: Down in the old barrows under Hyjal. Very quiet, everyone's asleep. Druids having a very long nap: my kind of place! Wish you were here!
bg_barrow.ogre: OLD TOMB. ELF SLEEP. LONG NAP. ME LIKE. WISH U HERE.

bg_hyjal.name: HYJAL SUMMIT
bg_hyjal.back: The World Tree is enormous! Snow on the pines and green lights in the sky. Didn't climb it. Probably not allowed. Wish you were here!
bg_hyjal.ogre: BIG BIG TREE. SNOW. GREEN SKY. NO CLIMB. WISH U HERE.

bg_ony.name: ONYXIA'S LAIR
bg_ony.back: Lovely cave full of eggs and gold. Onyxia did her deep breath, which was very warm. Many whelps. I mean MANY. Wish you were here!
bg_ony.ogre: EGG CAVE. GOLD. DRAKE LADY BLOW FIRE. MANY WHELP. WISH U HERE.

dragon_over_the_fairway.name: DRAGON FAIRWAY
dragon_over_the_fairway.back: Lovely round today, apart from the dragon. It circled all morning and ate my ball on the ninth. Still my best score. Wish you were here!
dragon_over_the_fairway.ogre: GOLF DAY. BIG DRAKE IN SKY. DRAKE EAT BALL. WISH U HERE.

floating_sky_spa.name: THE SKY SPA
floating_sky_spa.back: Greetings from above the clouds! Massage on a cloud, very fluffy. Don't look down. I looked down. Wish you were here!
floating_sky_spa.ogre: SPA IN SKY. FLUFF CLOUD. NO LOOK DOWN. ME LOOK. WISH U HERE.

ghost_ship_cove.name: GHOST COVE
ghost_ship_cove.back: Foggy cove, creaky old ship, crew a bit see-through. Lovely once you get used to the moaning. Bring a towel. Wish you were here!
ghost_ship_cove.ogre: FOGGY COVE. GHOST BOAT. CREW SAY OOOO. WISH U HERE.
